source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted interfaces declare termAsString, matchKeyword input and parseCondition input as AUTF8String. Native GetTermAsString assembles the attribute/operator and UTF-8 value bytes; MsgTermListToString wraps native terms in condition grammar. The JavaScript virtual-folder wrapper also joins term.termAsString, saves searchStr and calls parseCondition when reconstructing terms. The legacy account manager writes that stored condition as a terms= byte record. Check the declared interface encoding as well as the native serializer when text crosses JavaScript, native code and a file. This patch changes those interface declarations and native arguments; it adds no data migration or direct non-ASCII save/reload assertion. The generated XPCOM conversion implementation and arbitrary legacy-file compatibility are not certified here.
title: Virtual-folder search serialization needs an explicit UTF-8 interface boundary
